segments.text: This is Max and Mia podcast.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz mæks ənd ˈmiə ˈpɔdˌkæst/

segments.text: Hello, hello everyone.
segments.ipa: /həˈloʊ həˈloʊ ˈɛvriˌwʌn/

segments.text: Welcome back to Max and Mia podcast. I'm Max.
segments.ipa: /ˈwɛlkəm bæk tu mæks ənd ˈmiə ˈpɔdˌkæst aɪm mæks/

segments.text: And I'm Mia.
segments.ipa: /ənd aɪm ˈmiə/

segments.text: It's so great to have you with us again today.
segments.ipa: /ɪts soʊ ɡreɪt tu hæv ju wɪð ʌs əˈɡɛn təˈdeɪ/

segments.text: Today, we've got an excellent episode for you.
segments.ipa: /təˈdeɪ wiv ɡɑt æn ˈɛksələnt ˈɛpəˌsoʊd fɔr ju/

segments.text: One that's really going to put your listening skills to the test. It's true.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ðæts ˈrɪli ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu pʊt jɔr ˈlɪsənɪŋ skɪlz tu ðə tɛst ɪts tru/

segments.text: This one's a lot of fun, too.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs wʌnz ə lɑt ʌv fʌn tu/

segments.text: Has this ever happened to you?
segments.ipa: /hæz ðɪs ˈɛvər ˈhæpənd tu ju/

segments.text: You're watching a show, listening to a song, or talking to a native speaker,
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ə ʃoʊ ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu ə sɔŋ ɔr ˈtɔkɪŋ tu ə ˈneɪtɪv ˈspikər/

segments.text: and suddenly you freeze because you're not sure what they just said.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈsʌdənli ju friz bɪˈkɔz jʊr nɑt ʃʊr wʌt ðeɪ dʒʌst sɛd/

segments.text: Like, did they say fill or feel?
segments.ipa: /laɪk dɪd ðeɪ seɪ fɪl ɔr fil/

segments.text: Did they say three or tree? Exactly.
segments.ipa: /dɪd ðeɪ seɪ θri ɔr tri ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: Those tiny sound differences can be so confusing, especially when everything's moving fast.
segments.ipa: /ðoʊz ˈtaɪni saʊnd ˈdɪfərənsɪz kæn bi soʊ kənfˈjuzɪŋ əˈspɛʃli wɛn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋz ˈmuvɪŋ fæst/

segments.text: So, that's what we're doing today.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðæts wʌt wir ˈduɪŋ təˈdeɪ/

segments.text: We're going to train our ears to catch those small but important differences.
segments.ipa: /wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu treɪn ˈaʊər ɪrz tu kætʃ ðoʊz smɔl bʌt ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈdɪfərənsɪz/

segments.text: And even more important than that, we're going to learn how to understand what someone means just by paying attention to context.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈivɪn mɔr ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt ðæn ðæt wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu lɝn haʊ tu ˌʌndərˈstænd wʌt ˈsʌmˌwʌn minz dʒʌst baɪ ˈpeɪɪŋ əˈtɛnʃən tu ˈkɑntɛkst/

segments.text: That skill is honestly a game-changer.
segments.ipa: /ðæt skɪl ɪz ˈɑnəstli ə game-changer/

segments.text: We've got two typical English conversations ready for you today, and you'll hear several of these tricky sounds pop up naturally as the conversations unfold.
segments.ipa: /wiv ɡɑt tu ˈtɪpəkəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənz ˈrɛdi fɔr ju təˈdeɪ ənd jul hir ˈsɛvrəl ʌv ðiz ˈtrɪki saʊndz pɑp ʌp ˈnætʃərəli æz ðə ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənz ənˈfoʊld/

segments.text: One thing before we start, try not to rely on subtitles this time. Right.
segments.ipa: /wʌn θɪŋ bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt traɪ nɑt tu rɪˈlaɪ ɑn ˈsʌbˌtaɪtəlz ðɪs taɪm raɪt/

segments.text: The whole point is to lean on the context of the conversation itself.
segments.ipa: /ðə hoʊl pɔɪnt ɪz tu lin ɑn ðə ˈkɑntɛkst ʌv ðə ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən ˌɪtˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Let your brain fill in the gaps the way it would in real life.
segments.ipa: /lɛt jɔr breɪn fɪl ɪn ðə ɡæps ðə weɪ ɪt wʊd ɪn ril laɪf/

segments.text: So, get comfortable, open your ears, and let's dive into our first conversation. Hey, Ann.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɡɛt ˈkʌmfərtəbəl ˈoʊpən jɔr ɪrz ənd lɛts daɪv ˈɪntu ˈaʊər fɝst ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən heɪ æn/

segments.text: How was your weekend?
segments.ipa: /haʊ wɑz jɔr ˈwiˌkɛnd/

segments.text: You said you were going somewhere, right?
segments.ipa: /ju sɛd ju wɝ ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwɛr raɪt/

segments.text: Oh my gosh, yes.
segments.ipa: /oʊ maɪ ɡɑʃ jɛs/

segments.text: I finally got to visit my cousin's farm.
segments.ipa: /aɪ ˈfaɪnəli ɡɑt tu ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈkʌzənz fɑrm/

segments.text: It was amazing, honestly. Nice.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈɑnəstli naɪs/

segments.text: What's it like out there?
segments.ipa: /wʌts ɪt laɪk aʊt ðɛr/

segments.text: Well, it's pretty quiet.
segments.ipa: /wɛl ɪts ˈprɪti ˈkwaɪət/

segments.text: They've got this huge field full of sheep, like dozens of them just wandering around. Sheep?
segments.ipa: /ðeɪv ɡɑt ðɪs hjudʒ fild fʊl ʌv ʃip laɪk ˈdʌzənz ʌv ðɛm dʒʌst ˈwɑndərɪŋ ərˈaʊnd ʃip/

segments.text: That sounds peaceful.
segments.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz ˈpisfəl/

segments.text: Did you get to pet any of them? I did.
segments.ipa: /dɪd ju ɡɛt tu pɛt ˈɛni ʌv ðɛm aɪ dɪd/

segments.text: One of them came right up to me and I swear it just wanted attention.
segments.ipa: /wʌn ʌv ðɛm keɪm raɪt ʌp tu mi ənd aɪ swɛr ɪt dʒʌst ˈwɔntɪd əˈtɛnʃən/

segments.text: It was so soft, too. That's adorable.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz soʊ sɑft tu ðæts əˈdɔrəbəl/

segments.text: So, how did you even get there?
segments.ipa: /soʊ haʊ dɪd ju ˈivɪn ɡɛt ðɛr/

segments.text: Is it far from the city?
segments.ipa: /ɪz ɪt fɑr frʌm ðə ˈsɪti/

segments.text: Actually, it's on this little island, so we had to take a ship to get across.
segments.ipa: /ˈækˌtʃuəli ɪts ɑn ðɪs ˈlɪtəl ˈaɪlənd soʊ wi hæd tu teɪk ə ʃɪp tu ɡɛt əˈkrɔs/

segments.text: It only took about an hour, but I felt a bit seasick, not going to lie. Oh, no.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈoʊnli tʊk əˈbaʊt æn ˈaʊər bʌt aɪ fɛlt ə bɪt ˈsiˌsɪk nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu laɪ oʊ noʊ/

segments.text: Did you have a seat inside, at least? Yeah, thankfully.
segments.ipa: /dɪd ju hæv ə sit ˌɪnˈsaɪd æt list jæ ˈθæŋkfəli/

segments.text: I found a nice seat by the window, so I could just watch the water and try to relax. Smart move.
segments.ipa: /aɪ faʊnd ə naɪs sit baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ soʊ aɪ kʊd dʒʌst wɑtʃ ðə ˈwɔtər ənd traɪ tu rɪˈlæks smɑrt muv/

segments.text: So, what did you guys do once you got there?
segments.ipa: /soʊ wʌt dɪd ju ɡaɪz du wʌns ju ɡɑt ðɛr/

segments.text: We mostly just hung out, walked around the fields, ate way too much food.
segments.ipa: /wi ˈmoʊstli dʒʌst hʌŋ aʊt wɔkt ərˈaʊnd ðə fildz eɪt weɪ tu mʌtʃ fud/

segments.text: My cousin's mom made this incredible pie and I had like three slices. Three?
segments.ipa: /maɪ ˈkʌzənz mɑm meɪd ðɪs ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbəl paɪ ənd aɪ hæd laɪk θri ˈslaɪsəz θri/

segments.text: Okay, that's impressive.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ðæts ˌɪmˈprɛsɪv/

segments.text: I have zero regrets.
segments.ipa: /aɪ hæv ˈzɪroʊ rɪˈɡrɛts/

segments.text: Oh, and get this.
segments.ipa: /oʊ ənd ɡɛt ðɪs/

segments.text: There's this massive old tree right in the middle of the property.
segments.ipa: /ðɛrz ðɪs ˈmæsɪv oʊld tri raɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə ˈprɑpərti/

segments.text: Apparently, it's over a hundred years old.
segments.ipa: /əˈpɛrəntli ɪts ˈoʊvər ə ˈhʌndrəd jɪrz oʊld/

segments.text: Woah, that's wild.
segments.ipa: /Woah ðæts waɪld/

segments.text: A tree that old must have seen a lot. For sure.
segments.ipa: /ə tri ðæt oʊld mʌst hæv sin ə lɑt fɔr ʃʊr/

segments.text: We actually had a little picnic under it one afternoon.
segments.ipa: /wi ˈækˌtʃuəli hæd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈpɪkˌnɪk ˈʌndər ɪt wʌn ˌæftərˈnun/

segments.text: It was really calming, you know?
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz ˈrɪli ˈkɑmɪŋ ju noʊ/

segments.text: Just sitting there, listening to the wind.
segments.ipa: /dʒʌst ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɛr ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu ðə waɪnd/

segments.text: That sounds like exactly what you needed after such a busy month at work. Honestly, yeah.
segments.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ju ˈnidəd ˈæftər sʌtʃ ə ˈbɪzi mʌnθ æt wɝk ˈɑnəstli jæ/

segments.text: I've been feeling kind of drained lately, so it was nice to just breathe for a bit.
segments.ipa: /aɪv bɪn ˈfilɪŋ kaɪnd ʌv dreɪnd ˈleɪtli soʊ ɪt wɑz naɪs tu dʒʌst brið fɔr ə bɪt/

segments.text: Speaking of feeling drained, are you still thinking about moving?

segments.text: Last time we talked, you mentioned wanting to leave your apartment. Oh, right.
segments.ipa: /læst taɪm wi tɔkt ju ˈmɛnʃənd ˈwɑntɪŋ tu liv jɔr əˈpɑrtmənt oʊ raɪt/

segments.text: Yeah, I do want to leave eventually.
segments.ipa: /jæ aɪ du wɑnt tu liv ɪˈvɛntʃəwəli/

segments.text: My lease is almost up, anyway.
segments.ipa: /maɪ lis ɪz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ʌp ˈɛniˌweɪ/

segments.text: But, I think I'm going to live somewhere closer to downtown next.
segments.ipa: /bʌt aɪ θɪŋk aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu laɪv ˈsʌmˌwɛr ˈkloʊsər tu ˈdaʊnˈtaʊn nɛkst/

segments.text: That makes sense.
segments.ipa: /ðæt meɪks sɛns/

segments.text: Less commuting, more stuff to do. Exactly.
segments.ipa: /lɛs kəmˈjutɪŋ mɔr stʌf tu du ɪɡˈzæktli/

segments.text: Plus, where I live now, everything's so far away.
segments.ipa: /plʌs wɛr aɪ laɪv naʊ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋz soʊ fɑr əˈweɪ/

segments.text: I'm tired of driving 40 minutes just to grab dinner.
segments.ipa: /aɪm ˈtaɪərd ʌv ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈmɪnəts dʒʌst tu ɡræb ˈdɪnər/

segments.text: Totally get that.
segments.ipa: /ˈtoʊtəli ɡɛt ðæt/

segments.text: Hey, did you end up filling out that application for the new place?
segments.ipa: /heɪ dɪd ju ɛnd ʌp ˈfɪlɪŋ aʊt ðæt ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən fɔr ðə nu pleɪs/

segments.text: I did, actually.
segments.ipa: /aɪ dɪd ˈækˌtʃuəli/

segments.ipa: /aɪ hæd tu fɪl aʊt laɪk faɪv ˈdɪfərənt fɔrmz/

segments.text: It was kind of a lot.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz kaɪnd ʌv ə lɑt/

segments.text: But I think it's finally done. Good.
segments.ipa: /bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈfaɪnəli dʌn ɡʊd/

segments.text: I'm glad you got through it.
segments.ipa: /aɪm ɡlæd ju ɡɑt θru ɪt/

segments.text: Applications like that always feel so tedious. Right?

segments.text: But I feel a lot better now that it's over.
segments.ipa: /bʌt aɪ fil ə lɑt ˈbɛtər naʊ ðæt ɪts ˈoʊvər/

segments.text: Fingers crossed I hear back soon.
segments.ipa: /ˈfɪŋɡərz krɔst aɪ hir bæk sun/

segments.text: I bet you will.
segments.ipa: /aɪ bɛt ju wɪl/

segments.text: So, are you going to wait until you hear back before you start packing? Probably, yeah.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu weɪt ənˈtɪl ju hir bæk bɪˈfɔr ju stɑrt ˈpækɪŋ ˈprɑbəˌbli jæ/

segments.text: I don't want to jump the gun.
segments.ipa: /aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tu dʒʌmp ðə ɡʌn/

segments.text: Although, I really should start organizing my closet regardless.
segments.ipa: /ˌɔlˈðoʊ aɪ ˈrɪli ʃʊd stɑrt ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzɪŋ maɪ ˈklɑzət rəˈɡɑrdləs/

segments.text: I have no idea what I even own anymore. Same.

segments.text: I always forget what's in there until I actually go looking.
segments.ipa: /aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz fərˈɡɛt wʌts ɪn ðɛr ənˈtɪl aɪ ˈækˌtʃuəli ɡoʊ ˈlʊkɪŋ/

segments.text: Oh, and speaking of clothes, I need your opinion on something.
segments.ipa: /oʊ ənd ˈspikɪŋ ʌv kloʊðz aɪ nid jɔr əˈpɪnjən ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/

segments.text: Where would you wear a formal dress?
segments.ipa: /wɛr wʊd ju wɛr ə ˈfɔrməl drɛs/

segments.text: Like an outdoor wedding or something fancier?
segments.ipa: /laɪk æn ˈaʊtˌdɔr ˈwɛdɪŋ ɔr ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfænsiər/

segments.text: Depends on the dress, honestly.
segments.ipa: /dɪˈpɛndz ɑn ðə drɛs ˈɑnəstli/

segments.text: What's it look like?
segments.ipa: /wʌts ɪt lʊk laɪk/

segments.text: It's this new one I got.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ðɪs nu wʌn aɪ ɡɑt/

segments.text: Dark green, kind of long.
segments.ipa: /dɑrk ɡrin kaɪnd ʌv lɔŋ/

segments.text: I actually didn't even know I had it until I found it in a bag from months ago.

segments.text: Wait, you forgot you bought a dress? I know. It's ridiculous.

segments.text: But yeah, I think it'd work for something like an evening event.
segments.ipa: /bʌt jæ aɪ θɪŋk ˈɪtəd wɝk fɔr ˈsʌmθɪŋ laɪk æn ˈivnɪŋ ɪˈvɛnt/

segments.text: Maybe a dinner party.
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ə ˈdɪnər ˈpɑrti/

segments.text: That sounds right.
segments.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz raɪt/

segments.text: You'll have to send me a picture when you wear it.

segments.text: I will, promise.
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɪl ˈprɑməs/

segments.text: Anyway, enough about me.

segments.text: How was your weekend?
segments.ipa: /haʊ wɑz jɔr ˈwiˌkɛnd/

segments.text: Did you end up going to that concert? I did.
segments.ipa: /dɪd ju ɛnd ʌp ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðæt ˈkɑnsərt aɪ dɪd/

segments.text: It was honestly one of the best shows I've been to in a while.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz ˈɑnəstli wʌn ʌv ðə bɛst ʃoʊz aɪv bɪn tu ɪn ə waɪl/

segments.text: The lights were incredible, too.
segments.ipa: /ðə laɪts wɝ ˌɪnˈkrɛdəbəl tu/

segments.text: Like this whole synchronized display. Oh, nice.
segments.ipa: /laɪk ðɪs hoʊl ˈsɪŋkrəˌnaɪzd dɪˈspleɪ oʊ naɪs/

segments.text: I love when they do that.
segments.ipa: /aɪ lʌv wɛn ðeɪ du ðæt/

segments.text: Was it super crowded?
segments.ipa: /wɑz ɪt ˈsupər ˈkraʊdəd/

segments.text: A bit, yeah, but we got there early enough to grab a decent spot.
segments.ipa: /ə bɪt jæ bʌt wi ɡɑt ðɛr ˈɝli ɪˈnʌf tu ɡræb ə ˈdisənt spɑt/

segments.text: My legs were killing me by the end, though.

segments.text: Worth it, though, right?
segments.ipa: /wɝθ ɪt ðoʊ raɪt/

segments.text: Completely worth it.
segments.ipa: /kəmˈplitli wɝθ ɪt/

segments.text: I'd go again in a heartbeat.

segments.text: Feels good catching up like this. Definitely.

segments.text: We should do this more often, honestly. Agreed.
